task_metadata.task_goal: Reconcile multiple evidence sources into one review-ready workpaper.

scenario_spec.role: You are a Senior Auditor preparing a review package for a manager.
scenario_spec.business_context: The team has received a compact evidence package and needs a review-ready conclusion with clear provenance. The sampled capabilities include Reconcile Audit Evidence from Multiple Sources; Reconcile Source Totals to Report Line Items; Branch or Segment Data Aggregation with Selection.
scenario_spec.time_context: Current-period review with all source evidence provided in the reference package.

requirements: reconcile source totals to the requested reporting view
identify evidence gaps that affect confidence

visible_requirements: Review the provided reference files and produce the requested deliverable.
Cite the evidence IDs or source labels that support each material conclusion.
Flag items that cannot be resolved from the provided evidence.
Reconcile source evidence to the control totals and explain material differences.
The task should exercise: Reconcile Audit Evidence from Multiple Sources; Reconcile Source Totals to Report Line Items; Branch or Segment Data Aggregation with Selection.
hidden_requirements: Do not reward unsupported conclusions that lack visible evidence citations.
Treat unresolved evidence gaps separately from confirmed exceptions.
The teacher run should expose intermediate cross-check or reconciliation states.
Exact grading anchors must be traceable to visible policy or requirement evidence.
style_constraints: use only the provided reference files
